review_comments: zassert_false evaluates a boolean operation but k_pipe_put return an integer. Although C interprets anything != 0 as true it is not semantically correct IMHO. Would be better if you use zassert_equal here or `k_pipe_put(...) != 0`

ok, just want to confirm that this is really what you want to check. Looking the test, I think you want to check that the return of `k_pipe_put` was greater than 0, since `min_xfer` is 1. Also, if the function returns a negative value in case of error you need to assert as well.

Hi @ceolin , sorry for delay, and I want to test at least min_xfer bytes of data were written.,  a negative value was returned if pipe is not working normally. So I add this assert to check. @s-kelvin , is this right?
